New optional prop onRetry?: (segmentId: string) => void (component stays presentational). New optional field reasonCode?: string on SegmentRenderMonitorSegment. SegmentAccessibleTable gained an Actions column (Details/Retry, new required props onOpenDetail/onRetry) as the M6 keyboard-reachable equivalent to the popover. Positioning follows ScriptView.tsx's selection-popover pattern.

Task 011 (2026-07-11): the 10-60 segment full-field branch now delegates to <SegmentBlockRow height={10} onBlockClick={openPopoverFor} /> (extracted to SegmentBlockRow.tsx) instead of an inline block-mapping JSX block; behavior unchanged.
